follow-on: the EDAS rescan on_match now writes accessor/data_class/data_class_letter/unit from the scanned signal for every row in an EDAS-flagged batch, including MBDB/LCDB rows that set no data_class_letter; it is safe today because Cypher yields null for an absent map key, but the batch-wide flag assumes the scanner owns every EDAS row's fields.
